name: proxima-gateway

scripts.test: node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-timeout=20000 test/unit.test.js test/integration.test.js test/contract.test.js test/redact.test.js test/leak.test.js test/engines.test.js test/regression.test.js test/cli.test.js

scripts.test:all: npm run test:coverage && npm run test:browser
